analysis:
The only change in this PR is to docs/developer/test.md, in the head range 142-153. It rewrites the CI build-cache description: only pushes to dev/master save a cache, pull requests restore the base branch's entry and save nothing, and the MiMo audio gate runs only when its inputs change. The supplied units are the unchanged base text from lines 457 to 1385, which I read as context. They include the add-on hold tests (TB-012, T-059, T-060), App Attest dispatch and native serving qualification (TB-011), checkpoint storage and the encrypted SSD cache tests (T-041), and the logout and endpoint-resumption tests (A-008). No code, configuration, authorization, crypto, wire-protocol, cache-storage or trust-boundary behavior is modified, and none of those documented tests or controls is altered.

The CI cache change has one security-adjacent aspect. A pull request no longer writes cache entries, so a PR-controlled build can no longer poison cache entries that later builds restore. That narrows the attack surface and does not widen it. The patch excerpt covers the changed head range 142-153 and is marked complete. The build.md#ci-caching link target and scripts/ci-component-paths.py are outside the supplied evidence, so I did not verify them. The change does not invalidate any threat-model assumption, and the documented test content is pre-existing. I raise no findings. Integration has no cross-file questions to resolve, because the patch touches a single documentation file.
